title: DiffSyn guides synthesis of a high-silica UFI zeolite
summary: DiffSyn is a diffusion model trained on synthesis recipes and conditioned on zeolite structure and organic template. Researchers synthesized a UFI material using generated routes and report an ICP Si/Al ratio of 19.0. UFI is an existing framework; the result is a model-guided synthesis route and measured composition, not discovery of a new framework. Expected thermal stability is not presented as a measured outcome.

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broad deployment are not established by this review.
evidence.ai_role: A diffusion model proposes synthesis routes from structure/template conditioning; researchers synthesize and characterize a candidate material.
